result:
`Array.prototype.slice` is implemented in `crates/kahvi-builtins/src/array/prototype_slice.rs`, with each spec step kept as a comment above its code. `./t262 built-ins/Array/prototype/slice/` now gives 126 of 142 runs passing, up from 8. Clippy is clean and the engine builds.

The 16 remaining failures all hit "not implemented" paths outside my file: `Function` (6), `Proxy [[Get]]` (6), `Proxy [[DefineOwnProperty]]` (2), and `Object.preventExtensions` (2).

I also added a local `to_clamped_index` helper in my file, copied from the one in `prototype_splice.rs`, since `ops` has no `ToClampedIndex`. It is the only change outside the spec steps, and other built-ins could share it if the ticket owner wants it moved into `ops`.
